x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
import math

g = math.gcd(x, y)
x //= g
y //= g

d = 1.0
eps = 1e-10

xx = 0
yy = 1
ansxx = 0
ansyy = 1

for yy in range(1, n + 1):
    while abs(d * x / y - d * xx / yy) > abs(d * x / y - d * (xx + 10000) / yy):
        xx += 10000
    while abs(d * x / y - d * xx / yy) + eps > abs(d * x / y - d * (xx + 1) / yy):
        xx += 1
    if abs(d * x / y - d * xx / yy) < abs(d * x / y - d * ansxx / ansyy):
        ansxx = xx
        ansyy = yy

result = max(0, ansxx - (1 if y == 2 and ansxx != x else 0))
print(f"{result}/{ansyy}")
